gap: No result ChatGPT got states what a working linked pair costs today, meaning two units plus the required hub with stock status. 2x EcoFlow DELTA Pro + Double Voltage Hub is $3,737 for 7,200 W and in stock. 2x DELTA Pro 3 + 50 Amp Hub is $5,897 for 8,000 W, but the DELTA Pro 3 is sold out until late January. 2x Anker F3800 Plus + Smart Home Power Kit is $5,499.99, while the single F3800 Plus is sold out. 2x BLUETTI Apex 300 + Hub A1 can only be bought as a $5,699 bundle with batteries, because the $139 hub is sold out. No result states either that Jackery's own Connector page says a linked 2000 Plus pair adds nothing to 120 V loads.
standout_why: Compared against the two cited rivals, thepowerstationguide.com/blog/connect-two-portable-power-stations and ecoflow.com/us/blog/chain-two-portable-power-station, and ChatGPT's own answer tables. Both rival pages list models, hubs and combined watts but give no price for any unit, hub or linked system. The Power Station Guide shows only 'Check Price on Amazon' buttons. Neither page gives stock status. Neither says that the Jackery and BLUETTI Fusion Box doubling applies at 240 V and not to 120 V current. ChatGPT priced DELTA Pro 3 at $3,399 per unit; EcoFlow's US store shows $2,799 and sold out. It priced F3800 Plus at $2,999.99; Anker's store shows $2,399.99 and sold out. It never priced a hub or a complete pair.
decides: This changes the pick. ChatGPT leads with DELTA Pro 3 and F3800 Plus, but both single units are sold out on the makers' US stores today. The DELTA Pro 3 restock is late January. The cheapest in-stock way to double output is the original EcoFlow DELTA Pro pair with the $139 Double Voltage Hub: $3,737 for 7,200 W 120/240 V and 7.2 kWh. That is about $2,160 less than a DELTA Pro 3 pair, which adds only 800 W. For 12 kW, the in-stock option priced today is the $5,499.99 2x F3800 Plus + Smart Home Power Kit. A three-unit DELTA Pro 3 system needs the $1,499 Smart Home Panel 2, for $9,896 before installation. A shopper whose loads are 120 V should skip the Jackery 2000 Plus pair, because Jackery says only one unit feeds 120 V loads.
